title: TaskForge research artifact: pre-registered ablation study of overload controls for multi-tenant background task execution
description: Reproducible research artifact for TaskForge, a Redis-backed Go task runtime: pre-registered analysis plan, 504 raw experiment runs (6 workloads x 7 variants x 12 seeds), deterministic bootstrap analysis code, derived figures, and the paper draft. Every table and figure regenerates from the committed raw data with one documented command. Not yet archived; this metadata is prepared for a future, human-approved Zenodo deposit.
